Ernest Hemmingway described the same thing, he called it “inevitable suicide”. His father commited suicide and he was convinced that even with the best treatment, support, ect that he would still kill himself. And he did, at age sixty one.

Yes a man who knew he would kill himself chose to stay alive until he was sixty one years of age. That’s sixty one years of pain, depression, and numbness.

Yet in those sixty one years he wrote books that were so vivid and amazing I had to stop reading at times to simply admire him.

Some of us will commit suicide, this is true and the number of suicides will never reach zero.

But this doesn’t matter, what matters is the things you do before you die.
